tvs.title-bl6: Gel nail manicures – examples of our work
tvs.title-bl-seo: At Lbar, you can get every type of manicure in Bucharest.
tvs.text-bl-seo: We don't stop at quality care – we always achieve perfect results with every type of manicure:
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
• Classic. This is the basic cut manicure for women and men. The artist gives the nails the ideal shape and buffs their surface, removing the cuticle with fine scissors or nippers.
  • European. Instead of cutting the cuticle, the artist gently pushes it back toward the nail's growth zone with an orange stick. This manicure method is most often preferred in Bucharest by people with thin cuticles. The nail shape is then corrected, followed by buffing.
  • E-file. Using a special device with a range of different bits, the artist gently files the cuticle, gives the nails the desired shape and buffs the nail plate. An e-file manicure helps restore ridged and peeling nails.
  • SPA manicure. Here, more attention goes to the skin of the hands: massage and exfoliation for deep cleansing are followed by an oil treatment that leaves the skin velvety soft. For the nails – standard shaping and buffing.
  • Polish. Application of regular nail polish or gel. We have one of the widest manicure color palettes in Sector 1. Any other type of manicure can be finished with polish – colored or clear.
  • Men's. Men's manicure is in high demand in Bucharest. It can be done with the classic or the e-file method and may include callus removal, nail shape correction, treating and softening dry patches of skin, and a cream massage. On request, the artist will apply a clear polish to strengthen the nail plate.
